# Vendored StateBridge alignment source

This directory preserves the original `methods/state_bridge.py` from [YanwenPneg/StateBridge](https://github.com/YanwenPneg/StateBridge) at commit `3f6bf5442c6e8848555a6132516e6d36f35444fb`, together with its original Apache License 2.0 file. The source SHA256 is `415957df427eb79a4212e760af4d133cb4ce10cc4619f11447082117922f366d`.

The full source file is retained without changes. The contextual information assay will parse its syntax and extract only `_align_hidden_sequence`; it will not import or run the surrounding author application. The assay's GPTNeoX hook adapter, instrumentation, reference calculations, inverse and reports are separate Research3 code. No claim is made that this small CPU assay reproduces the authors' model/task evaluations.

Upstream paper: [StateBridge: Training-free Hidden-state Alignment for Latent Communication in LLM Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.13317). Authors: Yanwen Peng, Delvin Ce Zhang, Xi Wang and Nikolaos Aletras.
